text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Switch EXCAVA to Anthropic’s latest Claude 3.7 Sonnet. It’s the only model that delivers a measurable jump in reasoning depth without adding latency, proven by benchmarks where it outperforms peers on complex tasks like multi-step problem solving. The trade-off is higher cost per token, but the net gain in output quality justifies it—especially when even a 0.5% improvement in EXCAVA’s capability compounds over time.

name: Torque
text: The real risk isn’t just cost—it’s benchmark drift. EXCAVA’s live task accuracy already lags behind static benchmarks, and Sonnet 3.7’s 0.7% gain in lab tests won’t survive if its edge disappears in production. Test it on a 100-task subset of EXCAVA’s real workload for a week; if the delta stays positive, switch. Otherwise, the upgrade is noise.
